purpose: Bounded Codex-side grammar for secondary and tertiary hard-surface detail; it does not write Runtime/CAS and is not a Blender or arbitrary-script API.

detail_layers.intent: global silhouette, mass distribution and envelope
panel hierarchy, structural transitions and major vents
detail_layers.gate: one feature explains one visible seam or functional transition

detail_layers.intent: small plates, grooves, fasteners, ports and cable interfaces
detail_layers.gate: must be assigned to a focus region and close-up evidence

detail_layers.intent: scratches, grain, fine engraving and tiny wear
detail_layers.gate: defer to bake/PBR; do not turn all micro detail into geometry

constraints: must not change the primary envelope
must have one named parent Part
must not float or cross an unexplained fold

feature_tokens.semantic: recessed feature line or interface seam
constraints: follow one continuous line flow
stop before a major crease
do not use material contrast to hide a missing groove
spacing must be monotonic
array must remain inside its host Part
part-id and material-id must isolate the array

feature_tokens.semantic: ring, latch, hinge or fastener group
constraints: must explain a connection
no duplicate coincident rings
strict manifold readback required

feature_tokens.semantic: cable or tube entering a housing
constraints: path endpoints must terminate on named Parts
no unsupported free-floating cable
avoid silhouette changes unless explicitly reviewed

feature_tokens.semantic: raised or engraved motif on an existing surface
constraints: planned only until a bounded projection/relief operator is active
must not cross a primary crease
must not hide a failed silhouette
must have a focus-region close-up
core and seat are separate semantic Parts
emissive material cannot compensate for missing housing
check occlusion and intersection in close-up

feature_tokens.semantic: thin light guide or status indicator
constraints: must be attached to a host Part
must remain subordinate to the primary form
do not claim shader/VFX parity from a static emissive factor

composition_rules.symmetry_policy: mirror only when the source brief explicitly supports bilateral symmetry; otherwise use separate semantic Parts
composition_rules.density_policy: increase detail near functional transitions and focus regions; keep broad panels quiet

failure_modes: detail added to compensate for a failed primary silhouette
ornament crossing a major crease or changing the envelope
all surfaces equally noisy with no visual hierarchy
micro-detail modeled as geometry instead of normal/roughness/decal channels
a material or emissive change used to hide a geometry regression

structural_checks: zero floating-detail findings when a validator is available
validation_contract.quality_claim: not eligible for high-quality acceptance until reference-bound close-up compare and human review exist
